title: Each account is available, held until the provider's reset, or broken, as its own live request decided
description: Recorded outputs of this week's false holds (Z.ai fixture text, a wrong-key and shared-plan usage reading, a Claude JSON fragment, Claude's weekly-limit message) set quota only through each account's own live request: a passing request makes it available whatever usage, notices or worker text said; a refusal holds it until the reset the provider stated, in its words; any other failure is broken. A held account is checked again within the hour and at its reset, and a master's mark is replaced only by a newer live check. On the served dashboard at 1280 px and 390 px, the Workers page lists each account in one line: available, held until <time> with the provider's words, or broken, with when it was last checked live, and nothing scrolls sideways.
